digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store baseline persistence
propositions: Baseline storage should normalize description field through normalize_rich_text and persist status/priority as exact Jira name strings (e.g. 'High', 'In Progress') instead of vendor-shaped dicts to reduce file size by approximately 66%
Assignee field must preserve the raw dict, all identity forms, and presence bit unchanged to prevent local-wins from overwriting concurrent remote edits and maintain inbound suppression logic
Live field comparison through compute_update_fields with real JiraBackend mappers must produce identical mutation verdicts whether baselines are stored as vendor dicts or normalized scalars
Pre-A3 baseline reader must accept both scalar and vendor-dict shapes for description/status/priority without lossy denormalization or data migration
Corpus measurement across 1,774 baselines must show zero mutation deltas in both forward (current code) and rollback (pre-A3 code) directions and achieve at least 50% serialized-byte reduction
